findings.title: Secret Scrubber Regex Hyphen Leak (sk-proj-... / sk-ant-...)
findings.description: Regex `(?i)(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,})` does not match hyphens, leaving modern project keys unredacted.
findings.impact: Exposure of modern OpenAI and Anthropic project credentials in logs and database.
findings.cve_or_cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information

findings.title: Hallucination Index Formula Divergence Between Spec and Code
findings.description: Implementation uses `1.0 - Faithfulness` instead of weighted formula `1.0 - (0.40*F + 0.35*G + 0.25*CP)`.
findings.impact: Low groundedness answers do not trigger hallucination alerts if faithfulness is high.
findings.cve_or_cwe: CWE-684: Incorrect Provision of Specified Functionality

root_cause_analyses.title: Secret Scrubber Leaks Modern Hyphenated API Keys (sk-proj-... / sk-ant-...)
root_cause_analyses.description: The secret redaction regex `(?i)(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,})` does not include hyphens `-`. OpenAI project-scoped keys (`sk-proj-...`) and Anthropic keys (`sk-ant-...`) contain hyphens, causing the regex to stop matching after the prefix, leaving the actual sensitive key secret exposed in trace payloads and persisted SQLite records.
evidence_trace: Verified Payload Output: Key remained intact in redacted trace text instead of being replaced with [REDACTED_API_KEY]
reproduction_steps: 1. Instantiate RequestTrace with prompt containing `Authorization: Bearer sk-proj-12345-abcdef1234567890`
4. Observe that `sk-proj-12345-abcdef1234567890` is NOT replaced with `[REDACTED_API_KEY]`

root_cause_analyses.title: Hallucination Index Formula Divergence Between Spec and Implementation
root_cause_analyses.description: Specification and architecture documents define Hallucination Index as `1.0 - (0.40 * Faithfulness + 0.35 * Groundedness + 0.25 * Context Precision)`. The actual implementation in `backend/src/integrations/ragas.rs:107` simplifies this to `(1.0 - record.faithfulness).max(0.0)`. This completely discards Groundedness and Context Precision weights from the composite score.
evidence_trace: Verified Divergence: Groundedness & Context Precision delta of up to 0.40 unaccounted for
reproduction_steps: 1. Provide evaluation test case with Faithfulness=0.90, Groundedness=0.30, Context Precision=0.40
2. Documented formula expected score: 1.0 - (0.40*0.90 + 0.35*0.30 + 0.25*0.40) = 1.0 - (0.36 + 0.105 + 0.10) = 0.435 (High Hallucination alert triggered)
4. Severe hallucination and ungrounded output goes undetected

root_cause_analyses.title: Documented API Route Prefixing Mismatch (/api/* vs /api/v1/*)
root_cause_analyses.description: Architecture diagrams and README specify `/api/models`, `/api/experiments`, etc. The Axum router nests all business endpoints under `/api/v1/*` while leaving `/health` at the root `/health`. Any external client connecting to `/api/models` receives a 404 Not Found.
evidence_trace: Live Probe: HTTP GET http://localhost:8210/api/models yields 404 Not Found
Live Probe: HTTP GET http://localhost:8210/api/v1/models yields 200 OK
reproduction_steps: 4. Note 200 OK response with model records

repair_proposals.title: Patch Secret Scrubber Regex to Cover Modern Project & Anthropic Keys
repair_proposals.rationale: Updating the OpenAI regex from `(?i)(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,})` to include hyphens and underscores `(?i)(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,})` ensures modern project-scoped tokens (e.g., `sk-proj-...`) and Anthropic tokens (`sk-ant-...`) are completely redacted into `[REDACTED_API_KEY]` before logging or persistence.
repair_proposals.side_effects_assessment: Low risk. Valid prompts containing arbitrary words will not be affected unless they match the `sk-` prefix with 20+ alphanumerics, hyphens, or underscores.
repair_proposals.rollback_instructions: Revert `backend/src/observability/mod.rs` to commit HEAD using `git checkout backend/src/observability/mod.rs`.

repair_proposals.title: Align Hallucination Index Formula with Documented Multi-Metric Weighted Architecture
repair_proposals.rationale: Update `backend/src/integrations/ragas.rs` to compute the Hallucination Index using the documented weighted formula: `1.0 - (0.40 * Faithfulness + 0.35 * Groundedness + 0.25 * Context Precision)`. This ensures low groundedness or irrelevant context triggers hallucination alerts even if faithfulness is falsely high.
repair_proposals.side_effects_assessment: Moderate. Existing benchmarks with low groundedness (< 0.75) will now correctly transition `is_hallucinated` to `true`, triggering alert thresholds as designed in the system architecture.
repair_proposals.rollback_instructions: Restore the single-metric calculation: `let hallucination_index = (1.0 - record.faithfulness).max(0.0);`.

repair_proposals.title: Add Route Aliases in Axum Router for Root /api/* Endpoints
repair_proposals.rationale: Nests the router at both `/v1` and the root `/` under `/api` to maintain backwards compatibility with documentation and legacy clients expecting `/api/models` while preserving `/api/v1/models` versioning.
repair_proposals.diff:
--- a/backend/src/api/mod.rs
+++ b/backend/src/api/mod.rs
@@ -32,7 +32,8 @@ pub fn create_router(pool: SqlitePool) -> Router {
 
     // Nest under /api/v1 and provide alias for unversioned /api
     Router::new()
-        .nest("/api/v1", v1_routes)
+        .nest("/api/v1", v1_routes.clone())
+        .nest("/api", v1_routes)
         .route("/health", get(health_check))
repair_proposals.side_effects_assessment: Negligible. Extends route matching so both `/api/*` and `/api/v1/*` resolve successfully without modifying handler logic or database interactions.
